ideas.title: Minnesota's Ongoing Fraud Problem: An In-Depth Investigation
ideas.description: This story would delve into the extensive fraud issues in Minnesota, examining the causes, effects, and the state's response to these problems.
questions: What are the root causes of Minnesota's fraud problem?
How effective are current state efforts to combat fraud?
ideas.insight: An in-depth investigation into Minnesota's fraud problem could uncover significant issues with state oversight and accountability.

ideas.title: The Impact of FBI Jet Usage on Investigations
ideas.description: This story would explore the controversy surrounding FBI jet usage for personal travel and its impact on investigations.
questions: How does FBI jet usage affect investigations?
What are the implications of personal travel on FBI resources?
ideas.insight: Examining FBI jet usage could reveal issues with resource allocation and potential impacts on investigations.
